lockup.summary: Directors, executives and holders of nearly all shares agreed not to sell for 180 days after the prospectus date. The underwriters can allow sales sooner with written consent.

what: Electra Therapeutics develops antibody medicines that remove disease-causing immune cells, aiming to treat immune-mediated diseases and cancer.
proceeds: It expects about $319.9 million in net proceeds. It plans to fund trials of its lead drug ipsoprubart and its drug ELA822, and to pay for other research, working capital and general costs.
risks: Electra is young, has no approved products and has never earned revenue, so its chances of success are hard to judge.
It has lost money every period and expects bigger losses ahead. It may never make a profit.
Even after this offering, it will need much more money, and may have to cut or delay its programs if it cannot raise it.
